reviews.title: Great head set
reviews.comment: I bought this gaming head set because it was like the one I owned before. I like this one, I love the fact it is wireless. The battery lasts a while, the microphone is nice, it fits great. And I love how you can adjust the ear pieces. I wear glasses so it's hard to find a gaming headset the doesnt hurt my head when wearing glasses. These are the best worth the money. These also can blue tooth to your phone or computer which is nice. All around these are really good and I'm glad I bought them.

reviews.title: Great sound
reviews.comment: I’ve only used these for one game of COD so far, I’ll update this if necessary, but wow. I am really impressed by the sound quality. A coworker recommended this brand to me and I think she was correct. Update-it broke after 3 weeks. The ear piece kinda fell off for no apparent reason. Trying to return, which isn’t as easy as it used to be.

reviews.title: Love these!
reviews.comment: Definitely a good headset! Love that it’s wireless and you can use Bluetooth for connecting, also you can use an app for audio settings if want to. They are super comfortable on my head and easy to use. The mic is a flip mic so you can just flip it up to mute!
reviews.author: Madison Jolley

reviews.title: Great headset- minor flaws
reviews.comment: Pros: The sound quality is great. It has the ability to play sound based off of directions sound is coming from in the game. If the noise is coming from the left on your screen it’ll play louder in the left earphone. Battery life is amazing. I play hours on hours and the lowest I’ve seen it get is to medium battery. Comfortably fits most head sizes. It has adjustable clips to move the ear muffs to fit your head better. The price here was considerably cheaper than Walmart. We bought my husbands from Walmart for $110.00. I think I paid around $70.00 on here for mine. Wish we’d checked here sooner. Sound quality is great, the mic is good as well. Cons: Connectivity is difficult. You have 2 options for connectivity, dual USB where it has a physical USB it connects to once it is plugged into your gaming console. This can be hit or miss if it will automatically connect each time you turn it on. Once it stops connecting it’s a pain to get back. The best way I’ve found to fix it is to fully power off the headset, unplug the USB from the gaming console and replug it in and reconnect it. It does have Bluetooth, which works good for phones/ smaller devices other than gaming consoles, but can be a pain connecting to your device. Once it is connected it will pretty much always reconnect automatically which is nice. Functionality is so-so. Randomly the sound will cut out and sound distorted, while it’s not all the time it is frustrating while you’re playing a heated match on arc. I would say the cons are very minimal issues with easy fixes, nothing major that would stop me from purchasing these. I’d rate this in a few ways: Sound: 10/10 Mic: 10/10 Connectivity to console/devices: 6/10 Comfortability: 8/10 Overall quality: 8.5/10 (in my opinion). This is a great headset and I’d recommend it to anyone who likes gaming. Especially if you’re into high quality games that require sound precision as these are also noise cancelling.
